```json
                  "lineNumber": 217,
                  "content": "  \"plan\": \"## Implementation plan\\n\\n### 1) Add NavigationOverlayKit dependency\\n- Add the Swift Package dependency in Xcode (SPM) and link it to the main app target so &amp;#96;iPhone_DeviceNavigationView&amp;#96; can import it.\\n- Update &amp;#96;miataru.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj&amp;#96; to include the package and product, matching the repo URL &amp;#96;https://github.com/bietiekay/NavigationOverlayKit&amp;#96;.\\n\\n### 2) Wire the overlay into the navigation view\\n- In &amp;#96;iPhone_DeviceNavigationView&amp;#96; add a &amp;#96;NavigationOverlayViewModel&amp;#96; state object and create/update it when a route is calculated and the mode is “current device → other device” (&amp;#96;isRouteReversed == false&amp;#96;).\\n- Place the overlay at the top of the map overlay stack in &amp;#96;mapWithModifiers&amp;#96; so it appears above the map but below other system overlays. This lines up with the existing overlay structure and your UI preference.\\n- Ensure the overlay is hidden when:\\n  - &amp;#96;isRouteReversed == true&amp;#96; (device → user mode) [... omitted end of long line]"
```

Auto-refresh for visitor history now mirrors the Devices tab behavior: it throttles by settings interval, respects visibility/app-active state, and refreshes on appear, app activation, and your own location updates. Manual pull-to-refresh still forces an immediate refresh.

Key changes:
- Added a visibility-aware `refreshIfNeeded` helper with throttling in `VisitorHistoryViewModel`, reusing `autoRefreshDeviceList` and `mapUpdateInterval`.
- Wired `iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView` to toggle visibility, respond to notifications, and force-refresh on pull-to-refresh/first load.

Code references:
```21:94:miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_VisitorHistoryView.swift
@MainActor
final class VisitorHistoryViewModel: ObservableObject {
    @Published var visitors: [MiataruVisitor] = []
    @Published var isLoading = false
    @Published var errorMessage: String? = nil
    
    private let settings = SettingsManager.shared
    private var lastRefresh: Date?
    
    var sortedVisitors: [MiataruVisitor] {
        visitors.sorted { $0.TimeStampDate > $1.TimeStampDate }
    }

    func refreshIfNeeded(isVisible: Bool, force: Bool = false) async {
        if force {
            lastRefresh = Date()
            await loadVisitorHistory()
            return
        }

        guard await shouldRefresh(isVisible: isVisible) else {
            return
        }

        lastRefresh = Date()
        await loadVisitorHistory()
    }
    // ...
    private func shouldRefresh(isVisible: Bool) async -> Bool {
        guard settings.autoRefreshDeviceList,
              isVisible else {
            return false
        }

        let isActive = UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active
        guard isActive else {
            return false
        }

        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)
        let now = Date()

        if let last = lastRefresh, now.timeIntervalSince(last) < interval {
            return false
        }

        return true
    }
}
```
